tickets.summary: Create database migration for notification_preferences table
tickets.description:
Create the notification_preferences table with the following schema:

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | bigint | PK, auto-increment |
| user_id | bigint | FK -> users.id, NOT NULL |
| channel | varchar(20) | NOT NULL, enum: 'email', 'push', 'sms', 'in_app' |
| category | varchar(50) | NOT NULL |
| enabled | boolean | NOT NULL, default true |
| created_at | timestamp | NOT NULL, default NOW() |
| updated_at | timestamp | NOT NULL, default NOW() |

Indexes:
- idx_notification_prefs_user_id ON (user_id)
- idx_notification_prefs_user_channel ON (user_id, channel) UNIQUE

Foreign key: user_id references users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
